dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Contributors: Dougal, William H., 1822-1895, engraver; United States. Army. Corps of Topographical Engineers, cartographer

Covers territory between Utah and Mexico, from the Colorado River to the Liano Estacado; shows trails and wagon roads, forts, expeditions and explorations of the Southwest; names places and known rivers and mountain ranges.
Includes text, note, and list of authorities and table of latitudes and longitudes.
Signed on verso: Millard Fillmore May 15, 1961.
dct_title_s: Territory and military department of New Mexico
